comments.value: FreezeFrame and CameraAnimation would be amazing, or something similar. VERY useful for all content creators and is now difficult to produce creative content

CameraAnimation + FreezeFrame, as a soon to be VRC content creator, would be absolutely incredible to have! Not only would it make some amazing shots for videos and streams even, but it would make the filming of not only shorts, but also VRC Films/Documentaries a lot easier to stand out.
UI Color Changing could be a nice little thing too. Just for the sake of cosmetic reasons, but it would be a nice little way to make your menu look unique. Maybe even add image support for it too!
These are all so useful for content creation would love to have them. Especially the camera animation/drone controls and freezeframe. Also avi rescaling would be nice.

I doubt they would add FreezeFrame and ViewPointTweaker since that would create some fuckery in public lobbies
Man... IF ONLY WE COULD MOD IT IN THE GAME.

@{62bb117e479c320ba96e669e|full_name}: The great thing about freeframe was that it has a secondary mod called VRCLibary which would enable you to see other peoples clones - If you didn't have this, it would only show them locally to yourself

The biggest selling point of FreezeFrame + CameraAnimation was that they worked together in terms of setting up scenes.
The example would be that you enabled FreezeFrame to record your movements and when you have made a clone that moves around in what you previously did on repeat by itself, you can then take your time with CameraAnimation and set up recording paths around the clones you've set up.
The greatest thing here is that everytime you ask your CameraAnimation to "Play" and record along the path you made, it will reset the positions of all clones, so you can with ease edit the camera pathway to fit in perfectly with your FreezeFrame clones. 
FreezeFrame also make you able to set up standstill clones from different avatars you have, so you can set up a scene and take pictures of it from a far afterwards, instead of having to ask multiple friends to do certain task each.
Especially for photography, FreezeFrame is just unmissable. I would love to see this functionality come back to VRChat. Without it it has become a lot harder to take decent avatar photos.

details:
-CameraResChanger: able to taking picture up to 16k Resolution
-CameraMinus: able to enlarge, shrinking the camera
-CameraAnimation: able to setup a route for camera to go/fly following that route (able to loop)
-FreezeFrame: able to create a freeze frame locally of self avatar at that specific moment when activated can be stacked and removed (make it able to recording player movement and play it back if possible please)
-Playerlist (if possible): convenient UI to see  the list of all player in current world (showing Ping/FPS)
-ViewPointTweaker (if possible): able to set view point position conveniently in game instead of doing it in unity
-UI color changing (if possible): able to custom menu UI color
This is some personally and friends suggestion, but i think there will be alot of user also want these feature so if you do like to implement these feature into the game it would be really great for most of user who love to taking picture and filming
Other great feature has been suggested by other user and i also upvoted it so if you have a check and also implement into the game we would be really appreciate it
